data.description: The Horse Spring Rider is a Play Orange horse with a handlebar, set on a spring. A child sits astride the horse, holds the handlebar and rocks it to and fro, much like a rocking horse. The horse is a classic shape that most children recognise, and it gives toddlers an easy introduction to balance play. It fits a play school, nursery or society garden, and its orange colour adds a warm contrast to green lawns. Because it takes up so little ground, you can place it near a toddler swing or small slide. Our warranty covers the roto-moulded horse for 3 years and the spring for 1 year. Ask us for a quote.

items.pText: The Horse Spring Rider is a Play Orange horse with a handlebar, set on a spring. A child sits astride the horse, holds the handlebar and rocks it to and fro, much like a rocking horse. The horse is a classic shape that most children recognise, and it gives toddlers an easy introduction to balance play. It fits a play school, nursery or society garden, and its orange colour adds a warm contrast to green lawns. Because it takes up so little ground, you can place it near a toddler swing or small slide. Our warranty covers the roto-moulded horse for 3 years and the spring for 1 year. Ask us for a quote.

The horse is roto-moulded and fixed to a steel spring, with a handlebar for grip. It is installed self-standing or grouted, depending on your base. Keep an impact-absorbing surface under the rider and check the handlebar, spring and base bolts at regular intervals.
